<translate>
'''Shining Sword Attack''' is Trunks' sword technique. It is the only strike attack that needs a weapon: you can only use it while holding the [[Special:MyLanguage/Brave Sword|Brave Sword]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Learning it ==

[[Special:MyLanguage/Trunks|Trunks]] teaches Shining Sword Attack for '''9,000 TP'''. He has no alignment requirement. You also need [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Control|Ki Control]] and at least 5% Power Release, and the technique must be equipped in a technique slot.
</translate>

<translate>
== How it works ==

Hold the [[Special:MyLanguage/Brave Sword|Brave Sword]] in your main hand and press the technique's slot key. As with every strike attack, it picks a target in front of you (your lock-on target first, then the last enemy you hit, otherwise the one closest to your crosshair) within a 6-block cone, or 12 blocks while flying, and you appear right in front of it. Its damage is your Strike Damage × 2.4.

If nothing is in range you rush forward for up to 2 seconds, or straight at your locked-on target, and strike the first enemy you reach; missing completely refunds 40% of the Ki and halves the cooldown. Rushing at an enemy that is rushing at you starts a [[Special:MyLanguage/Strike Clash|strike clash]]. Every strike attack also starts a short shared cooldown (3 seconds by default).
</translate>

<translate>
== Upgrades ==

Like every strike attack, it gains experience when it hits, which you can spend on damage and cooldown (−2.5% per level, up to −50%). See [[Special:MyLanguage/Strike Attacks|Strike Attacks]].
</translate>
